fusions.name: Long Draw
fusions.desc: Looses a fully drawn shaft of air that deals 32 damage, rising to 2 times that at its full reach of 9 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Fletched Gale
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows of air at once, spread apart, each of which deals 5 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Following Breeze
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.5 times as far.

fusions.name: True Flight
fusions.desc: Your wind damage cannot be resisted by the target.
